mgmt_bio.text: Jeffrey A. Miller is Chairman of the Board, President and Chief Executive Officer of Halliburton Company, the Houston-based oilfield services provider. He joined Halliburton in 1997 and held leadership roles of increasing responsibility, serving on the board since 2014; from 2014 to 2017 he was President and Chief Health, Safety and Environment Officer, from 2017 to 2018 President and CEO, and since 2019 Chairman, President and CEO. Earlier he served as Executive Vice President and Chief Operating Officer from September 2012 to July 2014 and as Senior Vice President, Global Business Development and Marketing from January 2011 to August 2012. His career includes energy industry assignments living in Angola, Indonesia, Venezuela and Dubai. He holds a bachelor's degree in agriculture and business from McNeese State University and an MBA from Texas A&M University.
